model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=500, random_state=42), default hyperparameters, all 8 features
notes: Stratified 80/20 random split (random_state=42) of 921 rows; zeros in insulin/skin_thickness/etc. were kept as values, not imputed. 14 test rows exactly duplicate training rows, which may slightly inflate accuracy (0.906 on the non-duplicated test rows).
